items.name: button

files.source:
<!--
  aihu-button — styled recipe (Plan 5 Task 5, master spec §9.2 / §9.4).

  Wraps a NATIVE <button> and forwards props. NO `$extends` — same rule as
  `input.aihu` / `textarea.aihu` / `label.aihu`: the native control already
  carries the role, the tab stop, Enter/Space activation and the disabled
  semantics, so extending `AihuButton` would FIGHT the template-rendered native
  element rather than add to it. Measured, not assumed: with `base: AihuButton`
  the HOST gains `role="button"` + `tabindex="0"` while still containing the
  focusable native `<button>` in its shadow root — nested interactive controls,
  two tab stops, and Enter activating twice (the base's keydown handler calls
  `this.click()` on the host, the inner button activates natively).

  `AihuButton` remains the right base for a host-as-button element that renders
  no inner control — use `@aihu/primitives/button` directly for that shape. For
  a worked class-extension recipe see `checkbox.aihu` / `switch.aihu`, which
  DO use `$extends:` because their hosts carry the behavior themselves.

  `aihu add` rewrites the `aihu-` prefix to the consumer's chosen prefix at copy
  time; after copy the consumer owns this source.

  variant: default | destructive | outline | ghost | link
  size:    sm | md | lg | icon
  slots:   button
  (The variant/size matrix is the registry catalog contract — see meta.json.
  These are reflected as `data-variant` / `data-size` and matched in @style below.)

  CSS attachment (R2): the compiled `@style` block below IS the shared
  Constructable StyleSheet — see `card.aihu`'s header. A recipe writes no
  registration and no `adoptedStyleSheets` code of its own.
-->

@state {
  import { cn } from '@aihu/css-engine/runtime/cn'

  let variant = prop({ default: 'default' })
  let size = prop({ default: 'md' })
  let disabled = prop({ default: false })
}

@template {
  <button
    type="button"
    data-slot="button"
    data-variant={variant}
    data-size={size}
    disabled={disabled}
    class={cn('aihu-button')}>
    <slot />
  </button>
}

@style {
  /* Base — semantic utilities (no raw colors). */
  .aihu-button {
    @apply inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md font-medium select-none
           transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 disabled:pointer-events-none;
  }

  /* Variant matrix — semantic tokens via var(--color-*); pack-invariant (R4). */
  .aihu-button[data-variant="default"] {
    background-color: var(--color-primary);
    color: var(--color-primary-foreground);
  }
  .aihu-button[data-variant="default"]:hover {
    background-color: var(--color-primary);
  }
  .aihu-button[data-variant="destructive"] {
    background-color: var(--color-destructive);
    color: var(--color-destructive-foreground);
  }
  .aihu-button[data-variant="destructive"]:hover {
    background-color: var(--color-destructive);
  }
  .aihu-button[data-variant="outline"] {
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    background-color: var(--color-background);
  }
  .aihu-button[data-variant="outline"]:hover {
    background-color: var(--color-accent);
  }
  .aihu-button[data-variant="ghost"] {
    background-color: transparent;
  }
  .aihu-button[data-variant="ghost"]:hover {
    background-color: var(--color-accent);
    color: var(--color-accent-foreground);
  }
  .aihu-button[data-variant="link"] {
    background-color: transparent;
    color: var(--color-primary);
    text-underline-offset: 4px;
  }
  .aihu-button[data-variant="link"]:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
  }

  /* Size matrix. */
  .aihu-button[data-size="sm"] {
    height: 2rem;
    padding-inline: 0.75rem;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
  }
  .aihu-button[data-size="md"] {
    height: 2.25rem;
    padding-inline: 1rem;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
  }
  .aihu-button[data-size="lg"] {
    height: 2.5rem;
    padding-inline: 2rem;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
  }
  .aihu-button[data-size="icon"] {
    height: 2.25rem;
    width: 2.25rem;
  }
}

items.name: dialog

files.source:
<!--
  aihu-dialog-backdrop — styled recipe piece (Phase 2, master spec §9.4 / §9.7).

  `<aihu-dialog-backdrop>` EXTENDS the headless AihuDialogBackdrop primitive
  (click-outside dismissal, reflects `data-state`) via the compiler's
  `$extends:` macro. Light DOM (`$shadow: 'light'`). The translucent scrim covers
  the viewport while open and fades out on close.

  MOTION (tailwind-animations port, Track A Slice 12). This is aihu's stand-in
  for the vendor's `.animate-dialog::backdrop` rules: `::backdrop` is a
  pseudo-element that exists only on a native `<dialog>`/fullscreen element, and
  aihu's dialog is a headless JS primitive over plain positioned elements — so
  the backdrop is a REAL element carrying the same `data-state`, and the fade is
  ported onto that instead. Animation is on by default; the
  `animate-dialog-duration-*` / `animate-dialog-easing-[…]` utilities retune it
  via the shared `--aihu-anim-dialog-*` custom properties. Full decision record:
  `packages/css-engine/crates/aihu-css-core/recipes/dialog.css`.

  `aihu add` rewrites the `aihu-` prefix (tag + selectors) at copy time.
-->

@state {
  import { AihuDialogBackdrop } from '@aihu/primitives/dialog'

  base: AihuDialogBackdrop
  shadow: 'light'
}

@template {
  <slot></slot>
}

@style {
  aihu-dialog-backdrop {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 40;
    background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-foreground) 50%, transparent);
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    will-change: opacity;
    transition:
      opacity var(--aihu-anim-dialog-duration, 350ms) ease,
      visibility 0s;
  }
  /* `visibility: hidden`, not `display: none` — see dialog-content.aihu's
     closed-state comment for why (the primitive never unmounts these elements,
     and `display` cannot be transitioned into without `allow-discrete`). The
     delayed `visibility` slot keeps the scrim painted for its whole fade-out. */
  aihu-dialog-backdrop[data-state="closed"] {
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    pointer-events: none;
    transition-delay: 0s, var(--aihu-anim-dialog-duration, 350ms);
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    aihu-dialog-backdrop:not([data-motion="always"]),
    aihu-dialog-backdrop[data-state="closed"]:not([data-motion="always"]) {
      transition-duration: 1ms;
      transition-delay: 0s;
    }
  }
}

<!--
  aihu-dialog-close — styled recipe piece (Phase 2, master spec §9.4 / §9.7).

  `<aihu-dialog-close>` EXTENDS the headless AihuDialogClose primitive (closes
  the dialog on activation, `role=button` when not a native button) via the
  compiler's `$extends:` macro. Light DOM (`$shadow: 'light'`). Positioned at the
  top-right corner of the content panel.

  `aihu add` rewrites the `aihu-` prefix (tag + selectors) at copy time.
-->

@state {
  import { AihuDialogClose } from '@aihu/primitives/dialog'

  base: AihuDialogClose
  shadow: 'light'
}

@template {
  <slot></slot>
}

@style {
  aihu-dialog-close {
    position: absolute;
    top: var(--space-4);
    right: var(--space-4);
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 1.5rem;
    height: 1.5rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    color: var(--color-surface-foreground);
    opacity: 0.7;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: opacity 0.15s;
  }
  aihu-dialog-close:hover {
    opacity: 1;
  }
  aihu-dialog-close:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }
}

<!--
  aihu-dialog-content — styled recipe piece (Phase 2, master spec §9.4 / §9.7).

  `<aihu-dialog-content>` EXTENDS the headless AihuDialogContent primitive
  (`role=dialog`, `aria-modal`, focus-trap + return-focus, Escape-to-close,
  `aria-labelledby`/`aria-describedby`) via the compiler's `$extends:` macro.
  Light DOM (`$shadow: 'light'`) is required so the focus trap can see the
  consumer's children. Only the DEFAULT `<slot/>` projects in light DOM, so the
  consumer composes the title/description/close as plain children.

  MOTION (tailwind-animations port, Track A Slice 12). The panel animates in and
  out — it is NOT an instant `display` cutover any more. The animation is ON BY
  DEFAULT rather than opt-in behind an `animate-dialog-*` class: a modal that
  snaps into existence is the anomaly, not the enhancement, and the registry's
  job is to ship the good default. The `animate-dialog-*` UTILITIES stay the
  opt-in half — they only reconfigure this built-in motion by overriding the
  `--aihu-anim-dialog-*` custom properties it reads, so
  `<aihu-dialog-content class="animate-dialog-from-left animate-dialog-duration-200">`
  works without the component knowing anything about those classes. The full
  decision record for the family lives in
  `packages/css-engine/crates/aihu-css-core/recipes/dialog.css`.

  `aihu add` rewrites the `aihu-` prefix (tag + selectors) at copy time.
-->

@state {
  import { AihuDialogContent } from '@aihu/primitives/dialog'

  base: AihuDialogContent
  shadow: 'light'
}

@template {
  <slot></slot>
}

@style {
  aihu-dialog-content {
    position: fixed;
    left: 50%;
    top: 50%;
    /* Centering rides on the INDIVIDUAL `translate` property, not on
       `transform: translate(-50%, -50%)`. The entrance uses the individual
       `scale` property, and the platform composes those as
       `translate · rotate · scale · transform`, all about one shared
       transform-origin — so a centering offset parked in `transform` gets
       scaled by the entrance, drifting the panel by (1 − scale) · width / 2
       (~10px on a 32rem panel at scale 0.96) for the whole animation. With the
       centering in `translate` instead, `scale` resolves about the panel's true
       centre and nothing drifts. This is also why the family's start offset is
       two SCALAR custom properties rather than upstream's packed pair: only
       scalars compose into the `calc()`s below. */
    translate: -50% -50%;
    scale: 1;
    z-index: 50;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 32rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--space-4);
    padding: var(--space-6);
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background-color: var(--color-surface);
    color: var(--color-surface-foreground);
    box-shadow: 0 10px 30px color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-foreground) 25%, transparent);
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    will-change: opacity, translate, scale;
    /* `visibility 0s` is a real slot in the list, not a no-op — the closed rule
       below delays exactly that slot so the panel stays rendered for its whole
       fade-out and only then leaves the a11y tree / tab order. */
    transition:
      opacity var(--aihu-anim-dialog-duration, 350ms) ease,
      translate var(--aihu-anim-dialog-duration, 350ms) var(--aihu-anim-dialog-easing, cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)),
      scale var(--aihu-anim-dialog-duration, 350ms) var(--aihu-anim-dialog-easing, cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)),
      visibility 0s;
  }
  /* The closed state is `visibility: hidden`, NOT `display: none`. The headless
     primitive never unmounts this element (it only flips `data-state`), so a
     permanently-rendered element needs neither `@starting-style` nor
     `transition-behavior: allow-discrete` nor `<aihu-presence-gate>` — but it
     DOES need a closed state that can be transitioned INTO, which `display`
     cannot be. `visibility` is the discrete property the platform transitions
     specially: delayed to the end of the fade, it holds the panel rendered
     throughout the exit and still removes it from the accessibility tree and
     the tab order once it lands. */
  aihu-dialog-content[data-state="closed"] {
    opacity: var(--aihu-anim-dialog-start-opacity, 0);
    translate:
      calc(-50% + var(--aihu-anim-dialog-start-x, 0px))
      calc(-50% + var(--aihu-anim-dialog-start-y, 1.5rem));
    scale: var(--aihu-anim-dialog-start-scale, 0.96);
    visibility: hidden;
    pointer-events: none;
    transition-delay: 0s, 0s, 0s, var(--aihu-anim-dialog-duration, 350ms);
  }
  aihu-dialog-content:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }
  /* Reduced motion is a hard requirement of this port. `animations.rs`'s
     `reduced_motion_guard` only covers keyframe-backed `animate-*` utilities,
     so a transition-driven surface carries its own guard — same
     `[data-motion="always"]` per-element escape hatch, and the duration is
     COLLAPSED rather than set to `transition: none` so `transitionend` still
     fires for anything listening. The `[data-state="closed"]` arm is load-
     bearing: without it the closed rule's `transition-delay` would still hold
     `visibility` for the full 350ms. */
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    aihu-dialog-content:not([data-motion="always"]),
    aihu-dialog-content[data-state="closed"]:not([data-motion="always"]) {
      transition-duration: 1ms;
      transition-delay: 0s;
    }
  }
}

@state { import { cn } from '@aihu/css-engine/runtime/cn' shadow: 'light' let color = prop({ default: '#ffd700' }) let pupilColor = prop({ default: '#1c1408' }) let speed = prop({ default: '1' }) let hostEl = state(null) // Read every prop into a differently-named local before use — an // options-object key textually identical to a prop name trips the // compiler's prop-auto-unwrap rewriter (see token-stream.aihu's header for // the exact failure mode). const irisColor = color const pupilColorValue = pupilColor const rateMultiplier = Math.max(0, Number(speed) || 0) const TAU = Math.PI * 2 /** Iris radius as a fraction of the host's shorter side. */ const IRIS_RADIUS_RATIO = 0.32 /** Glow halo radius as a multiple of the iris radius. */ const GLOW_RADIUS_RATIO = 2.2 /** Glow's breathing alpha ranges [BASE - AMPLITUDE, BASE + AMPLITUDE]. */ const GLOW_ALPHA_BASE = 0.28 const GLOW_ALPHA_AMPLITUDE = 0.18 /** Cycles per second (pre-`rateMultiplier`) for the glow's breathing and * each axis of the pupil's sweep. X and Y differ so the sweep traces a * Lissajous path rather than a degenerate straight line. */ const PULSE_FREQ = 0.15 const SWEEP_FREQ_X = 0.12 const SWEEP_FREQ_Y = 0.19 /** Pupil wander radius as a fraction of the iris radius; Y is scaled down * further so the scan reads as mostly side-to-side, like a search. */ const PUPIL_SWEEP_RATIO = 0.45 const PUPIL_SWEEP_Y_RATIO = 0.6 const PUPIL_RADIUS_RATIO = 0.42 const GLINT_ALPHA = 0.85 const draw = (ctx, width, height, t) => { ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height) const cx = width / 2 const cy = height / 2 const irisRadius = Math.min(width, height) * IRIS_RADIUS_RATIO if (irisRadius <= 0) return // Ambient glow: see the header's `globalAlpha` + `'transparent'`-stop // note — the far stop needs no relation to `irisColor`'s format, and the // pulse's peak brightness rides on `globalAlpha`, not a baked-in alpha. const pulse = GLOW_ALPHA_BASE + GLOW_ALPHA_AMPLITUDE * Math.sin(t * PULSE_FREQ * TAU) const glowRadius = irisRadius * GLOW_RADIUS_RATIO const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, glowRadius) glow.addColorStop(0, irisColor) glow.addColorStop(1, 'transparent') ctx.globalAlpha = pulse ctx.fillStyle = glow ctx.beginPath() ctx.arc(cx, cy, glowRadius, 0, TAU) ctx.fill() ctx.globalAlpha = 1 // Iris: a flat solid disc — see the header for why this is not a // light-core/dark-rim gradient. ctx.fillStyle = irisColor ctx.beginPath() ctx.arc(cx, cy, irisRadius, 0, TAU) ctx.fill() // Pupil: a Lissajous sweep, pure `sin` with no phase offset on either // axis, so `t = 0` is always a centered gaze (see the header's reduced // motion note). const sweep = irisRadius * PUPIL_SWEEP_RATIO const px = cx + Math.sin(t * SWEEP_FREQ_X * TAU) * sweep const py = cy + Math.sin(t * SWEEP_FREQ_Y * TAU) * sweep * PUPIL_SWEEP_Y_RATIO const pupilRadius = irisRadius * PUPIL_RADIUS_RATIO ctx.fillStyle = pupilColorValue ctx.beginPath() ctx.arc(px, py, pupilRadius, 0, TAU) ctx.fill() // Glint: a small fixed highlight offset up-left from the pupil's center, // so the eye reads as glossy rather than a flat dot. ctx.globalAlpha = GLINT_ALPHA ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff' ctx.beginPath() ctx.arc(px - pupilRadius * 0.35, py - pupilRadius * 0.35, pupilRadius * 0.3, 0, TAU) ctx.fill() ctx.globalAlpha = 1 } const handleFrame = (frame) => { const t = frame.reducedMotion ? 0 : (frame.timestamp / 1000) * rateMultiplier draw(frame.ctx, frame.width, frame.height, t) } useCanvasSurface(() => hostEl, { onFrame: handleFrame, }) } @template {
} @style { .aihu-goldeneye { display: block; position: absolute; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; pointer-events: none; } }

<!--
  aihu-input — presentational styled recipe (Phase 2, master spec §9.7).

  Wraps a NATIVE <input> and forwards props. NO `$extends` — the native control
  plus light DOM is enough for forms; extending a primitive would fight the
  template-rendered native element. `$shadow: 'light'` so the native <input>
  joins the outer <form>, and the recipe's class-scoped CSS reaches the global
  cascade. `aihu add` rewrites the `aihu-` prefix at copy time.
-->

@state {
  shadow: 'light'

  let type = prop({ default: 'text' })
  let placeholder = prop({ default: '' })
  let name = prop({ default: '' })
  let value = prop({ default: '' })
  const ariaLabel = prop({ default: '' })
  let disabled = prop({ default: false })
  let required = prop({ default: false })
}

@template {
  <input
    class="aihu-input"
    type={type}
    placeholder={placeholder}
    name={name}
    value={value}
    aria-label={ariaLabel}
    disabled={disabled}
    required={required} />
}

@style {
  .aihu-input {
    height: 2.25rem;
    width: 100%;
    padding: var(--space-1) var(--space-3);
    font-family: var(--font-sans);
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    line-height: 1.25rem;
    color: var(--color-foreground);
    background-color: transparent;
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s;
  }
  .aihu-input::placeholder {
    color: var(--color-muted-foreground);
  }
  .aihu-input:focus-visible {
    outline: none;
    border-color: var(--color-ring);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-ring) 35%, transparent);
  }
  .aihu-input:disabled {
    opacity: 0.5;
    cursor: not-allowed;
  }
  .aihu-input[aria-invalid="true"] {
    border-color: var(--color-destructive);
  }
}

@state { import { cn } from '@aihu/css-engine/runtime/cn' shadow: 'light' let count = prop({ default: '40' }) let color = prop({ default: '#ffffff' }) let connectionDistance = prop({ default: '120' }) let hostEl = state(null) // Read every prop into a differently-named local before use — an // options-object key textually identical to a prop name trips the // compiler's prop-auto-unwrap rewriter (see token-stream.aihu's header for // the exact failure mode). Snapshotting here also matches the composable // family's convention: attributes are read once at setup, not live. const nodeCount = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(count) || 0)) const inkColor = color const linkDistance = Math.max(0, Number(connectionDistance) || 0) const TAU = Math.PI * 2 /** Peak drift speed, px/sec, seeded per node in [-SPEED, SPEED] per axis. */ const SPEED = 14 const NODE_RADIUS = 2 const NODE_ALPHA = 0.85 /** Alpha of a connection at zero distance; it fades linearly to 0 at * `linkDistance`. */ const LINE_ALPHA = 0.45 const nodes = [] // Mutable scalars live on a const holder rather than as top-level `let`s: // `@state`'s reactive declarations are explicit (`state(...)`), and these // are deliberately plain frame-local bookkeeping that nothing renders from. const seeded = { width: 0, height: 0 } const seed = (width, height) => { nodes.length = 0 for (let i = 0; i < nodeCount; i++) { nodes.push({ x: Math.random() * width, y: Math.random() * height, vx: (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * SPEED, vy: (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * SPEED, }) } seeded.width = width seeded.height = height } /** Integrate one step. `dt` is SECONDS, clamped for the same reason * `useParticleField` clamps: a backgrounded tab resumes with a multi-second * delta and integrating that unclamped teleports the whole graph away in a * single frame. Nodes WRAP rather than bounce — a bouncing graph reads as * trapped, a wrapping one reads as ambient drift. */ const step = (dt, width, height) => { const clamped = dt > 0.05 ? 0.05 : dt for (const n of nodes) { n.x += n.vx * clamped n.y += n.vy * clamped if (n.x < -NODE_RADIUS) n.x += width + NODE_RADIUS * 2 else if (n.x > width + NODE_RADIUS) n.x -= width + NODE_RADIUS * 2 if (n.y < -NODE_RADIUS) n.y += height + NODE_RADIUS * 2 else if (n.y > height + NODE_RADIUS) n.y -= height + NODE_RADIUS * 2 } } /** Connections first, then nodes, so the dots sit ON TOP of the web rather * than being bisected by every line that terminates on them. */ const draw = (ctx, width, height) => { ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height) if (linkDistance > 0) { const maxSq = linkDistance * linkDistance ctx.strokeStyle = inkColor ctx.lineWidth = 1 for (let i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) { const a = nodes[i] for (let j = i + 1; j < nodes.length; j++) { const b = nodes[j] const dx = a.x - b.x const dy = a.y - b.y const distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy // Compare SQUARED distances to reject the vast majority of pairs // without a sqrt; only survivors pay for the real distance, which // the opacity ramp needs. if (distSq >= maxSq) continue ctx.globalAlpha = LINE_ALPHA * (1 - Math.sqrt(distSq) / linkDistance) ctx.beginPath() ctx.moveTo(a.x, a.y) ctx.lineTo(b.x, b.y) ctx.stroke() } } } ctx.globalAlpha = NODE_ALPHA ctx.fillStyle = inkColor for (const n of nodes) { ctx.beginPath() ctx.arc(n.x, n.y, NODE_RADIUS, 0, TAU) ctx.fill() } // Leave the context as we found it — a later `redraw()` must not inherit // the last node's alpha. ctx.globalAlpha = 1 } /** Re-seed only on the FIRST real size; re-randomizing on every resize tick * would make a window drag look like static. Later sizes rescale * proportionally so no node is stranded outside the new box. */ const handleResize = (width, height) => { if (nodes.length === 0) { seed(width, height) return } const sx = seeded.width > 0 ? width / seeded.width : 1 const sy = seeded.height > 0 ? height / seeded.height : 1 for (const n of nodes) { n.x *= sx n.y *= sy } seeded.width = width seeded.height = height } const handleFrame = (frame) => { if (nodes.length === 0) seed(frame.width, frame.height) // The reduced-motion contract: paint the graph, never integrate it. if (!frame.reducedMotion) step(frame.delta / 1000, frame.width, frame.height) draw(frame.ctx, frame.width, frame.height) } // Both callbacks are hoisted to named consts rather than written inline as // `onResize: (w, h) => { … }`. An options-object entry whose VALUE is a // multi-line arrow function is mis-parsed by the compiler's @state // macro/prop rewriter — it reads the `key:` as a state-macro declaration // and emits `let onResize: (width, height) => {`, which is not valid TS // (`Expected "}" but found "onResize"`). Same family of rewriter hazard as // the prop-name/option-key collision documented in token-stream.aihu; the // fix is the same shape — keep the object literal's values to bare // identifiers whose names differ from their keys. useCanvasSurface(() => hostEl, { onResize: handleResize, onFrame: handleFrame, }) } @template {
} @style { .aihu-node-graph-background { display: block; position: absolute; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; pointer-events: none; } }

files.source:
<!--
  aihu-popover-content — styled recipe piece (Phase 2, master spec §9.4 / §9.7,
  performativeUI port Slice 7).

  Design and behavior transcribed in spirit from performativeUI (MIT); no
  source text or `pui-` class names vendored — see NOTICES.md.

  `<aihu-popover-content>` EXTENDS the headless AihuPopoverContent primitive
  (`role="dialog"` WITHOUT `aria-modal`, positions against the trigger via the
  REUSED css-engine `position()` shim, reflects `data-state` /
  `data-placement`) via the compiler's `$extends:` macro. Light DOM
  (`$shadow: 'light'`). No side/align variants here — placement positioning is
  the primitive's job (inline `left`/`top`, read back off `coords`).

  MOTION. The panel animates in/out on by default, same technique as
  `dialog-content.aihu` (Track A Slice 12): the primitive never unmounts this
  element (only flips `data-state`), so the closed state uses a delayed
  `visibility: hidden` rather than `display: none` — no `@starting-style`/
  `allow-discrete` needed, and the panel stays rendered (and transitionable)
  for its whole exit.

  DELIBERATELY A SEPARATE `--aihu-anim-popover-*` custom-property family, NOT
  a reuse of `--aihu-anim-dialog-*`: reusing the dialog family's literal custom
  properties would let a consumer's `animate-dialog-*` utility class silently
  retune an unrelated component, and semantically a popover is not a dialog
  (see the primitive's accessibility.md "Not a dialog"). The entrance is also
  simpler than dialog's four-direction family — fade + zoom only, no directional
  offset — because `data-placement` is not yet known on the very FIRST open
  (the primitive sets `data-state="open"` and calls `_position()` in the same
  synchronous effect, but only the value written before that tick is what the
  transition animates FROM); a directional slide keyed off `data-placement`
  would silently do nothing on a component's first open and only start working
  from its second, which is a worse default than a placement-agnostic fade+zoom
  that is correct every time.

  `aihu add` rewrites the `aihu-` prefix (tag + selectors) at copy time.
-->

@state {
  import { AihuPopoverContent } from '@aihu/primitives/popover'

  base: AihuPopoverContent
  shadow: 'light'
}

@template {
  <slot></slot>
}

@style {
  aihu-popover-content {
    position: fixed;
    z-index: 50;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--space-2);
    min-width: 12rem;
    max-width: 20rem;
    padding: var(--space-4);
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background-color: var(--color-surface);
    color: var(--color-surface-foreground);
    box-shadow: 0 10px 30px color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-foreground) 20%, transparent);
    opacity: 1;
    scale: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    will-change: opacity, scale;
    /* `visibility 0s` is a real slot in the list — see dialog-content.aihu's
       comment on the same trick. The closed rule below delays exactly that
       slot so the panel stays rendered (and reachable by its own transition)
       for the whole fade-out, only then leaving the a11y tree / tab order. */
    transition:
      opacity var(--aihu-anim-popover-duration, 180ms) ease,
      scale var(--aihu-anim-popover-duration, 180ms) var(--aihu-anim-popover-easing, cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)),
      visibility 0s;
  }
  aihu-popover-content[data-state="closed"] {
    opacity: var(--aihu-anim-popover-start-opacity, 0);
    scale: var(--aihu-anim-popover-start-scale, 0.96);
    visibility: hidden;
    pointer-events: none;
    transition-delay: 0s, 0s, var(--aihu-anim-popover-duration, 180ms);
  }
  aihu-popover-content:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }
  /* Reduced motion is a hard requirement of this port (see status-dot.aihu).
     The `[data-state="closed"]` arm is load-bearing — without it the closed
     rule's `transition-delay` would still hold `visibility` for the full
     duration. */
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    aihu-popover-content:not([data-motion="always"]),
    aihu-popover-content[data-state="closed"]:not([data-motion="always"]) {
      transition-duration: 1ms;
      transition-delay: 0s;
    }
  }
}

<!--
  aihu-popover-root — styled recipe piece (Phase 2, master spec §9.4 / §9.7,
  performativeUI port Slice 7 — docs/plans/2026-08-01-performative-ui-port.md
  §Tier-B batch 3).

  Design and behavior transcribed in spirit from performativeUI (MIT); no
  source text or `pui-` class names vendored — see NOTICES.md.

  The state owner of the non-modal popover machine. `<aihu-popover-root>`
  EXTENDS the headless AihuPopoverRoot primitive (owns `open`/`placement`,
  provides the popover context, reflects `data-state`, binds the outside-
  pointerdown dismissal) via the compiler's `$extends:` macro — same shape as
  `dialog-root`/`tooltip-root`. Light DOM (`$shadow: 'light'`) so descendant
  pieces inject the context; `display: contents` keeps the root visually
  transparent.

  `aihu add` rewrites the `aihu-` prefix (tag + selectors) at copy time.
-->

@state {
  import { AihuPopoverRoot } from '@aihu/primitives/popover'

  base: AihuPopoverRoot
  shadow: 'light'
}

@template {
  <slot></slot>
}

@style {
  aihu-popover-root {
    display: contents;
  }
}

<!--
  aihu-popover-trigger — styled recipe piece (Phase 2, master spec §9.4 / §9.7,
  performativeUI port Slice 7).

  Design and behavior transcribed in spirit from performativeUI (MIT); no
  source text or `pui-` class names vendored — see NOTICES.md.

  `<aihu-popover-trigger>` EXTENDS the headless AihuPopoverTrigger primitive
  (toggles the popover, wires `aria-haspopup="dialog"` / `aria-expanded` /
  `aria-controls`, Enter/Space activation, Escape-dismiss) via the compiler's
  `$extends:` macro. Light DOM (`$shadow: 'light'`) so context injection
  reaches the ancestor root.

  UNLIKE `dialog-trigger` (deliberately unstyled — dialog openers are usually
  the consumer's own button), the trigger here carries REAL button-shaped
  styling: a popover is very often invoked from a bare icon or label with no
  other button around it, so shipping a good default affordance out of the box
  is the honest default. Styling mirrors `aihu-button`'s `outline` variant
  (border + background, not the `default` variant's solid primary fill) —
  a popover disclosure is a secondary action, not a primary CTA.

  `aihu add` rewrites the `aihu-` prefix (tag + selectors) at copy time.
-->

@state {
  import { AihuPopoverTrigger } from '@aihu/primitives/popover'

  base: AihuPopoverTrigger
  shadow: 'light'
}

@template {
  <slot></slot>
}

@style {
  aihu-popover-trigger {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: var(--space-2);
    height: 2.25rem;
    padding-inline: 1rem;
    font-family: var(--font-sans);
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--color-foreground);
    background-color: var(--color-background);
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    cursor: pointer;
    user-select: none;
    transition: background-color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s;
  }
  /* MEASURED, not assumed: `--color-accent` (#c8543a) as a SOLID fill
     against EITHER `--color-accent-foreground` (4.13:1) or `--color-foreground`
     (3.84:1) fails the 4.5:1 AA floor for this 14px/500-weight label — a real
     violation caught by `check-storybook-a11y.sh` on the `Open` story (the
     `[data-state="open"]` rule, not a `:hover` pseudo-class the gate happens
     to observe). Same 12%-tint-background + 60/40-color-mix-ink formula
     `eyebrow-pill.aihu`'s `tone="accent"` rule already measured and documents
     as fixing this exact token's contrast (its header comment: "accent
     3.56:1... lifts... to >=5.8:1"). */
  aihu-popover-trigger:hover {
    background-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-accent) 12%, var(--color-background));
    color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-accent) 60%, var(--color-foreground));
  }
  aihu-popover-trigger:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }
  aihu-popover-trigger[data-state="open"] {
    border-color: var(--color-accent);
    background-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-accent) 12%, var(--color-background));
    color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-accent) 60%, var(--color-foreground));
  }
  aihu-popover-trigger[aria-disabled="true"] {
    opacity: 0.5;
    cursor: not-allowed;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
}

items.name: temperature

files.source:
<!--
  aihu-temperature — styled recipe (Phase 2, performativeUI port Slice 7 —
  docs/plans/2026-08-01-performative-ui-port.md §Tier-B batch 3).

  Design and behavior transcribed in spirit from performativeUI (MIT); no
  source text or `pui-` class names vendored — see NOTICES.md.

  An AI-marketing "response temperature" segmented preset picker — three
  fixed values (Precise / Balanced / Creative), not a literal range input.

  DESIGN DECISION (roadmap: "builds on existing roving-focus + collection, no
  new menu primitive needed"): read as option (a) — a single-select group of
  buttons is *exactly* what `AihuRadioGroupRoot` already is (itself built on
  `roving-focus` + `collection`, per that primitive's own header comment), so
  `<aihu-temperature>` EXTENDS it directly via the compiler's `$extends:`
  macro, the same "IS its primitive" shape `switch.aihu`/`checkbox.aihu` use —
  no popover, no new menu primitive, no dropdown. The fixed three items are
  NOT a `<slot>`-composed, consumer-supplied list (this is deliberately a
  3-value PRESET control, not a general-purpose radio group recipe — see the
  roadmap's "keep it a 3-value fixed preset control unless you have good
  reason otherwise"); the three `<aihu-radio-group-item>` children are
  hardcoded in `@template`, registered via the primitive package's own
  `defineRadioGroup()` (imported as a side effect, same registration entry
  point `before-after.aihu`'s `defineSlider()` call uses).

  No `$prop` is declared: `AihuRadioGroupRoot` owns every attribute this needs
  (`value` / `default-value` / `name` / `disabled` / `required`, plus the
  inherited roving-focus `orientation` / `loop` / `dir`) — same "No $prop"
  convention `switch.aihu`/`checkbox.aihu` document. Nothing is selected by
  default (native radio-group parity: no selection submits nothing); set
  `default-value="balanced"` to seed one. The control has no built-in
  accessible name of its own — set `aria-label` directly on the host, e.g.
  `<aihu-temperature aria-label="Response style">`, same as any plain
  `role="radiogroup"` element would need.

  `shadow: 'light'` so the composed `<aihu-radio-group-item>` children sit in
  light DOM where `defineRadioGroup()`'s `customElements.define` takes effect
  on them directly (same rationale `before-after.aihu`'s header documents for
  its composed `<aihu-slider-root>`).

  `aihu add` rewrites the `aihu-` prefix (tag + selectors) at copy time.
-->

@state {
  import { defineRadioGroup, AihuRadioGroupRoot } from '@aihu/primitives/radio-group'

  base: AihuRadioGroupRoot
  shadow: 'light'

  defineRadioGroup()
}

@template {
  <aihu-radio-group-item class="aihu-temperature-item" value="precise">Precise</aihu-radio-group-item>
  <aihu-radio-group-item class="aihu-temperature-item" value="balanced">Balanced</aihu-radio-group-item>
  <aihu-radio-group-item class="aihu-temperature-item" value="creative">Creative</aihu-radio-group-item>
}

@style {
  aihu-temperature {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 2px;
    padding: 2px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
    /* `--color-secondary` / `--color-secondary-foreground` is a real fill/ink
       pair (unlike `--color-muted` / `--color-muted-foreground`, which are
       ramp neighbours, not a pair — see `chat-bubble.aihu`'s header comment
       for the measured 1.9:1 failure that token combination produces). */
    background-color: var(--color-secondary);
  }
  aihu-temperature[aria-disabled="true"] {
    opacity: 0.6;
  }
  .aihu-temperature-item {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding-block: 0.375rem;
    padding-inline: 0.875rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
    font-family: var(--font-sans);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--color-secondary-foreground);
    cursor: pointer;
    user-select: none;
    transition: background-color 0.15s, color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s;
  }
  .aihu-temperature-item:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }
  .aihu-temperature-item[data-state="checked"] {
    background-color: var(--color-surface);
    color: var(--color-surface-foreground);
    box-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-foreground) 15%, transparent);
  }
  .aihu-temperature-item[data-disabled] {
    opacity: 0.5;
    cursor: not-allowed;
  }
}

items.description: Styled 3-value response-temperature preset picker (Precise / Balanced / Creative) — light-DOM element extending the headless AihuRadioGroupRoot primitive (roving tabindex, arrow-key selection, native form participation).

<!--
  aihu-textarea — presentational styled recipe (Phase 2, master spec §9.7).

  Wraps a NATIVE <textarea> and forwards props. NO `$extends` — the native
  control plus light DOM is enough for forms. `$shadow: 'light'` so the native
  <textarea> joins the outer <form>, and the recipe's class-scoped CSS reaches
  the global cascade. `aihu add` rewrites the `aihu-` prefix at copy time.
-->

@state {
  shadow: 'light'

  let placeholder = prop({ default: '' })
  let name = prop({ default: '' })
  let value = prop({ default: '' })
  let rows = prop({ default: '3' })
  const ariaLabel = prop({ default: '' })
  let disabled = prop({ default: false })
  let required = prop({ default: false })
}

@template {
  <textarea
    class="aihu-textarea"
    placeholder={placeholder}
    name={name}
    value={value}
    rows={rows}
    aria-label={ariaLabel}
    disabled={disabled}
    required={required}></textarea>
}

@style {
  .aihu-textarea {
    min-height: 4rem;
    width: 100%;
    padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-3);
    font-family: var(--font-sans);
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    line-height: 1.25rem;
    color: var(--color-foreground);
    background-color: transparent;
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    resize: vertical;
    transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s;
  }
  .aihu-textarea::placeholder {
    color: var(--color-muted-foreground);
  }
  .aihu-textarea:focus-visible {
    outline: none;
    border-color: var(--color-ring);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-ring) 35%, transparent);
  }
  .aihu-textarea:disabled {
    opacity: 0.5;
    cursor: not-allowed;
  }
  .aihu-textarea[aria-invalid="true"] {
    border-color: var(--color-destructive);
  }
}

  (`role=tooltip`, positions against the trigger via the css-engine shim,
  reflects `data-state`) via the compiler's `$extends:` macro. Light DOM

  side/align variants here.

  `aihu add` rewrites the `aihu-` prefix (tag + selectors) at copy time.
-->

  base: AihuTooltipContent
  shadow: 'light'

}

    position: fixed;
    z-index: 50;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background-color: var(--color-primary);
    color: var(--color-primary-foreground);

    font-size: 0.75rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
    max-width: 18rem;
  }
  aihu-tooltip-content[data-state="closed"] {
    display: none;
  }
}

<!--
  aihu-tooltip-root — styled recipe piece (Phase 2, master spec §9.4 / §9.7).

  The state owner of the tooltip machine. `<aihu-tooltip-root>` EXTENDS the
  headless AihuTooltipRoot primitive (owns `open`/`placement`/delays, provides
  the tooltip context, reflects `data-state`) via the compiler's `$extends:`
  macro. Light DOM (`$shadow: 'light'`) so descendant pieces inject the context;
  `display: contents` keeps the root visually transparent.

  `aihu add` rewrites the `aihu-` prefix (tag + selectors) at copy time.
-->

@state {
  import { AihuTooltipRoot } from '@aihu/primitives/tooltip'

  base: AihuTooltipRoot
  shadow: 'light'
}

@template {
  <slot></slot>
}

@style {
  aihu-tooltip-root {
    display: contents;
  }
}

<!--
  aihu-tooltip-trigger — styled recipe piece (Phase 2, master spec §9.4 / §9.7).

  `<aihu-tooltip-trigger>` EXTENDS the headless AihuTooltipTrigger primitive
  (hover/focus open, Escape dismiss, `aria-describedby` the content) via the
  compiler's `$extends:` macro. Light DOM (`$shadow: 'light'`) so context
  injection reaches the ancestor root.

  `aihu add` rewrites the `aihu-` prefix (tag + selectors) at copy time.
-->

@state {
  import { AihuTooltipTrigger } from '@aihu/primitives/tooltip'

  base: AihuTooltipTrigger
  shadow: 'light'
}

@template {
  <slot></slot>
}

@style {
  aihu-tooltip-trigger {
    display: inline-flex;
  }
}
